---
pagetitle: "IRW homepage preview"
css: preview.css
format:
  html:
    # The project sets include-in-header to logos/_head.html; naming it again
    # here keeps it, because a document-level value replaces the project one
    # rather than adding to it. The robots meta is the reason for the override:
    # this is a preview, not a page that should be indexed or found in search.
    include-in-header:
      - logos/_head.html
      - text: |
          <meta name="robots" content="noindex">
---

<!--
preview.qmd -- PREVIEW of a redesigned homepage. Not linked from the navbar and
marked noindex; index.qmd is untouched and remains the live homepage.

Structure: hero (copy + rotating specimen card), family tiles, workflow cards,
then the existing homepage prose. The prose is a COPY, in preview/_prose_en.md,
not an include of welcome/welcome_en.md -- index.qmd includes that file, so
editing it in place would edit the live homepage. The redundancy edits approved
for this preview are applied to the copy only.

Numbers come from data/hero_stats.json, the same file the live hero reads, via
the same tolerant read: a missing or malformed file falls back rather than
failing the render, and any individual count that is absent is hidden instead of
printed as 0 or NA. See landing/hero_stats.R for what writes it. Note that
totals.n_tables there is nrow() of the CORE metadata table, not a grand total --
the other four families are counted separately into n_tables_comp/_nom/_conj/
_rank -- so the grand total is computed here as the sum of the five.

The specimen card reads data/specimens.json, written by specimens.R from a
hand-edited specimens_list.csv. The committed file is placeholders; the card
tags an entry whose "placeholder" is true. Nothing here calls Redivis from the
browser.

All CSS is in preview.css, scoped under .irw-home.
-->

```{r}
#| label: load-home-stats
#| include: false

library(jsonlite)

# Same contract as components/_hero_playful.qmd: data/hero_stats.json is written
# by the pre-render step landing/hero_stats.R and is not tracked, so it is
# missing only in a local render with no Redivis token. Fall back rather than
# fail, and let the page hide whatever is absent.
home_stats_fallback <- list(
  totals = list(
    n_tables = NULL, n_responses = NULL, n_participants = NULL,
    n_tables_comp = NULL, n_tables_nom = NULL, n_tables_conj = NULL, n_tables_rank = NULL
  )
)

home_stats <- tryCatch({
  parsed <- fromJSON("data/hero_stats.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
  if (!is.list(parsed$totals)) stop("hero_stats.json has no totals")
  parsed
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("preview.qmd: data/hero_stats.json missing or malformed (",
          conditionMessage(e), ") -- counts will be hidden.")
  home_stats_fallback
})

ojs_define(home_stats = home_stats)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: home-formatters
//| echo: false

// Copied from components/_hero_playful.qmd so the two pages format the same
// figure the same way. fmtAbbrev: 3 significant figures with a K/M/B suffix,
// trailing ".0" dropped. fmtInt: thousands-grouped, used for table counts.
fmtAbbrev = (n) => {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return "";
  const units = [[1e9, "B"], [1e6, "M"], [1e3, "K"]];
  for (const [threshold, suffix] of units) {
    if (Math.abs(n) >= threshold) {
      const scaled = n / threshold;
      const digits = Math.abs(scaled) >= 100 ? 0 : 1;
      return scaled.toFixed(digits).replace(/\.0$/, "") + suffix;
    }
  }
  return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
}

fmtInt = (n) => (n == null || isNaN(n)) ? "" : Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
```

```{ojs}
//| label: home-config
//| echo: false

totals = home_stats.totals || {}

// A count is shown only if it is a positive number; anything else is treated as
// absent and the number is dropped from the tile, as the live hero does.
count = (v) => (typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v) && v > 0) ? v : null

// One entry per family. Adding a family means adding an entry here: the tiles,
// the totals line and the specimen card's family buttons all read this list.
// `count` is the field in hero_stats.totals that holds that family's table
// count -- core's is n_tables, which is the core count and not a grand total.
FAMILIES = [
  { key: "core",         name: "Core",         count: count(totals.n_tables),
    href: "standard.html",
    desc: "A person answers an item; the response is ordered." },
  { key: "nominal",      name: "Nominal",      count: count(totals.n_tables_nom),
    href: "nominal_standard.html",
    desc: "Categories with no order, like kept distractors." },
  { key: "competitions", name: "Competitions", count: count(totals.n_tables_comp),
    href: "comps_standard.html",
    desc: "Two entities meet; one wins, or they draw." },
  { key: "rankings",     name: "Rankings",     count: count(totals.n_tables_rank),
    href: "rankings_standard.html",
    desc: "A person puts a set of options in order." },
  { key: "conjoint",     name: "Conjoint",     count: count(totals.n_tables_conj),
    href: "conjoint_standard.html",
    desc: "Choices between profiles built from attributes." }
]

// Six steps, in order. The last one gets the dashed pink treatment.
STEPS = [
  { name: "Find",       call: "irw_filter()",       href: "data.html",
    desc: "Filter on metadata before downloading anything." },
  { name: "Understand", call: "irw_info()",         href: "tables/",
    desc: "Provenance, licence and notes on every table page." },
  { name: "Fetch",      call: "irw_fetch()",        href: "getstarted.html",
    desc: "One call for every family, long format." },
  { name: "Analyze",    call: "irw_long2resp()",    href: "vignettes/index.html",
    desc: "Loop your method over hundreds of tables." },
  { name: "Cite",       call: "irw_save_bibtex()",  href: "getstarted.html",
    desc: "Credit the original data authors in one call." },
  { name: "Contribute", call: "validate.html",      href: "contribute.html",
    desc: "Validate your file; it becomes the next table.", accent: true }
]

specimens = FileAttachment("data/specimens.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| label: home-page
//| echo: false

homeRoot = {
  const esc = (s) => String(s == null ? "" : s)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");

  // specimens.json carries the family key ("competitions"), not its display
  // name; FAMILIES is the one place that spells the names, so read it from
  // there rather than title-casing the key.
  const famName = (key) => {
    const f = FAMILIES.find(x => x.key === key);
    return f ? f.name : String(key == null ? "" : key);
  };

  // ---- Totals line.
  //
  // The tables figure is the sum of the five families' counts, since
  // totals.n_tables is core only. n_participants and n_responses in
  // hero_stats.json are sums over the CORE metadata table alone, so they are
  // labelled as the core family's rather than passed off as warehouse-wide --
  // there is no grand total of either to read, and landing/hero_stats.R is not
  // this branch's to change. Any piece that is missing drops out of the line.
  const famCounts = FAMILIES.map(f => f.count).filter(c => c != null);
  const nTables = famCounts.length ? famCounts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) : null;
  const nPeople = count(totals.n_participants);
  const nResp = count(totals.n_responses);

  const totalsBits = [];
  if (nTables != null) totalsBits.push(`<strong>${fmtInt(nTables)}</strong> tables in all`);
  if (nPeople != null && nResp != null) {
    totalsBits.push(`the core family alone holds <strong>${fmtAbbrev(nPeople)}</strong> people and <strong>${fmtAbbrev(nResp)}</strong> responses`);
  } else if (nPeople != null) {
    totalsBits.push(`<strong>${fmtAbbrev(nPeople)}</strong> people in the core family`);
  } else if (nResp != null) {
    totalsBits.push(`<strong>${fmtAbbrev(nResp)}</strong> responses in the core family`);
  }
  const totalsLine = totalsBits.join(" · ");

  // ---- Tiles and steps.
  const tiles = FAMILIES.map(f => `
    <a class="tile" href="${esc(f.href)}">
      ${f.count != null ? `<span class="tile-count">${fmtInt(f.count)}</span>` : ""}
      <span class="tile-name">${esc(f.name)}</span>
      <span class="tile-desc">${esc(f.desc)}</span>
    </a>`).join("") + `
    <a class="tile next" href="contact.html">
      <span class="tile-count">+</span>
      <span class="tile-name">Next family</span>
      <span class="tile-desc">Have data that fits none of these? Tell us.</span>
    </a>`;

  const steps = STEPS.map((s, i) => `
    <li>
      <a class="step${s.accent ? " contribute" : ""}" href="${esc(s.href)}">
        <span class="step-n" aria-hidden="true">${i + 1}</span>
        <span class="step-name">${esc(s.name)}</span>
        <span class="step-desc">${esc(s.desc)}</span>
        <span class="step-call mono">${esc(s.call)}</span>
      </a>
    </li>`).join("");

  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "irw-home";
  root.innerHTML = `
    <section class="hero">
      <div class="hero-copy">
        <p class="eyebrow">AN OPEN WAREHOUSE OF RESPONSE DATA</p>
        <h1>Every table, documented, citable, one line away.</h1>
        <p class="subhead">Test answers, survey ratings, chess games, ranked ballots and choice experiments from hundreds of studies, reshaped so one analysis runs across all of them.</p>
        <div class="hero-actions">
          <a class="btn-solid" href="data.html">Explore the data</a>
          <a class="btn-ghost" href="https://doi.org/10.3758/s13428-025-02796-y">Read the paper</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <article class="specimen" id="irw-home-specimen" aria-live="polite"></article>
    </section>

    <section class="families" aria-labelledby="irw-home-families-h">
      <div class="families-inner">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2 id="irw-home-families-h">Explore by family</h2>
          ${totalsLine ? `<p class="totals">${totalsLine}</p>` : ""}
        </div>
        <div class="tiles">${tiles}</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="workflow" aria-labelledby="irw-home-workflow-h">
      <div class="workflow-head">
        <h2 id="irw-home-workflow-h">From a question to an analysis at scale</h2>
        <p>Six steps, each one a short call in the R or Python package.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="steps">${steps}</ol>
      <p class="loop-note">↺ Step 6 feeds step 1: contributed data becomes findable, fetchable and citable for everyone.</p>
    </section>
  `;

  // ---- Specimen card.
  //
  // Plain DOM with listeners rather than reactive cells, so the card's state
  // stays inside this one element. No auto-rotation: the reader advances it.
  // Opens on a random specimen so the page does not always lead with the same
  // family.
  const card = root.querySelector("#irw-home-specimen");
  const S = Array.isArray(specimens) ? specimens : [];

  if (!S.length) {
    card.innerHTML = `<p class="spec-meta">No specimens available.</p>`;
  } else {
    let i = Math.floor(Math.random() * S.length);

    const draw = () => {
      const d = S[i];
      const cols = Array.isArray(d.columns) ? d.columns : [];
      const rows = Array.isArray(d.rows) ? d.rows : [];
      // The 72px floor is what makes the wrapper scroll instead of crushing
      // cells on a narrow screen; see .spec-grid-wrap in preview.css.
      const grid = `grid-template-columns: repeat(${Math.max(cols.length, 1)}, minmax(72px, 1fr));`;

      const head = `<div class="spec-row head" style="${grid}">${
        cols.map(c => `<span>${esc(c)}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
      const body = rows.map((r, k) =>
        `<div class="spec-row${k % 2 ? " alt" : ""}" style="${grid}">${
          (Array.isArray(r) ? r : []).map(v => `<span>${esc(v)}</span>`).join("")}</div>`).join("");
      const more = (typeof d.n_rows === "number" && d.n_rows > 0)
        ? `<div class="spec-more">… ${fmtInt(d.n_rows)} rows</div>` : "";

      const pills = S.map((s, k) => {
        // One button per family present in the file. Several specimens can share
        // a family; the button goes to the first of them and the button for the
        // family on screen reads as pressed.
        const first = S.findIndex(x => x.family === s.family);
        return (first === k)
          ? `<button type="button" class="spec-pill" data-go="${k}" aria-pressed="${S[i].family === s.family ? "true" : "false"}">${esc(famName(s.family))}</button>`
          : "";
      }).join("");

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="spec-top">
          <span class="spec-pos">SPECIMEN ${i + 1} OF ${S.length}</span>
          <span style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
            ${d.placeholder ? `<span class="spec-fake">placeholder</span>` : ""}
            <span class="spec-chip">${esc(String(d.family || "").toUpperCase())}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="spec-head">
          <h2>${esc(d.title)}</h2>
          <div class="spec-meta">
            <span class="spec-name mono">${esc(d.table)}</span>
            <span>${esc(d.dims)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="spec-grid-wrap">${head}${body}${more}</div>
        <div class="spec-code">${esc(d.fetch)}</div>
        <div class="spec-foot">
          <div class="spec-pills" role="group" aria-label="Jump to a family">${pills}</div>
          <button type="button" class="spec-next" data-next="1">Show another →</button>
        </div>
        ${(!d.placeholder && d.page_url) ? `<p class="spec-page"><a href="${esc(d.page_url)}">Table page for ${esc(d.table)} →</a></p>` : ""}
      `;

      card.querySelectorAll("[data-go]").forEach(b =>
        b.addEventListener("click", () => { i = Number(b.dataset.go); draw(); }));
      card.querySelector("[data-next]")
        .addEventListener("click", () => { i = (i + 1) % S.length; draw(); });
    };

    draw();
  }

  return root;
}
```
